items.title: Houthi statement from Sanaa claims three operations against Saudi Arabia with ballistic and cruise missiles and drones. King Khalid Airport in Riyadh was hit and air traffic disrupted. The Aramco refinery in Rabigh was hit and set on fire. Abha Airport, the Khamis Mushait airbase, the Aqeefah camp in Asir and sites in Najran and Jizan were also hit. The Houthis say the attacks answer 60 Saudi airstrikes on Sanaa, Al-Jawf, Taiz, Hodeidah, Saada and Marib in the past 24 hours. Airlines were warned to halt flights through Saudi airspace, with Mecca and Medina excluded.

items.title: Yemen government taking control of the bab el mandab
items.summary:
Yemen government taking control of the bab el mandab
Open Source Intel (@Osint613)
UPDATED YEMEN MAP: Operation Yemen Dawn, October 5
Major movement along Yemen’s western coast today.
Yemeni government forces captured Dhubab Airport and Al Omari Base. Fighting has now reached Mokha, according to Al Arabiya. The Dhubab to Mokha road has been cut, with Houthi forces reportedly surrounded in Dhubab.
The Houthis are advancing around Taiz, capturing Al Turbah and pushing toward Al Nashma, threatening the Taiz to Aden route.
Government forces are also advancing in Marib and Al Jawf under heavy Saudi air cover, with around 100 aircraft reportedly involved in operations.
Mokha is now a key battlefield. Its loss would threaten the Houthis’ remaining position along the southern Red Sea coast and Bab el Mandeb.
Legend:
🟦 Yemeni government forces
🟥 Houthi forces
🟧 Contested
➡️ Government and Houthi advances
✈️ Saudi airstrikes
💥 Active battlefield
Source: OSINT613 monitoring

Well, who else would they have children with?”

items.title: Ukrainian Armor unveiled a Novator 2 equipped with a Ukrainian-made remote weapon station carrying a 12.7 mm Browning machine gun with 300 rounds, a thermal imager and digital sight. The company said the system achieved a 90% hit rate against targets at ranges of 100 to 1,000 meters during a demonstration. The module has completed research trials and is in the final stage of codification. It can also be installed on M113 and BRDM-2 vehicles. #Ukraine

items.title: ❗️Ukraine and Germany signed energy agreements worth over €155 million following the Ukrainian-German Business Forum, Energy Minister Denys Shmyhal says. Ukrenergo also agreed with German grid operators 50Hertz and Amprion to accelerate procurement of critical electrical equipment. #Ukraine

items.title: Quantum WIY Industries unveiled a concept under which Ukraine’s FP-1/FP-2 could serve as an airborne platform for eight SPYS interceptor drones, with four carried under each wing. SPYS is designed against aerial targets and has a stated 15 km range, 0.3 kg warhead, altitude up to 4 km and maximum speed of 480 km/h. It uses radar guidance to reach the target area and a terminal guidance system. The interceptor is currently undergoing testing. #Ukraine

items.title: RT by @Osint613: UPDATED YEMEN MAP: Operation Yemen Dawn, October 5 Major movement along Yemen’s western coast today. Yemeni government forces captured Dhubab Airport and Al Omari Base. Fighting has now reached Mokha, according to Al Arabiya. The Dhubab to Mokha road has been cut, with Houthi forces reportedly surrounded in Dhubab. The Houthis are advancing around Taiz, capturing Al Turbah and pushing toward Al Nashma, threatening the Taiz to Aden route. Government forces are also advancing in Marib and Al Jawf under heavy Saudi air cover, with around 100 aircraft reportedly involved in operations. Mokha is now a key battlefield. Its loss would threaten the Houthis’ remaining position along the southern Red Sea coast and Bab el Mandeb. Legend: 🟦 Yemeni government forces 🟥 Houthi forces 🟧 Contested ➡️ Government and Houthi advances ✈️ Saudi airstrikes 💥 Active battlefield Source: OSINT613 monitoring

The BND currently sees no indications of a large-scale Russian attack on NATO territory, but Jäger said lower-level Russian military activity could occur, particularly in the Baltic region. #Germany

items.title: Two people were killed after the ROYAD MAMMADOV, carrying Ukrainian grain to Italy, suffered an incident in the Black Sea near Romania, Digi24 reports. Thirteen crew members were initially reported missing, but 11 were subsequently rescued. Several Coast Guard vessels and a helicopter participated in the search-and-rescue operation. The cause of the incident has not been established, and there is no confirmation that the vessel was attacked.

items.title: ❗️NATO is developing a “Theory of Victory” strategy for rapidly repelling a potential Russian attack, BBG reports. Supreme Allied Commander Europe Gen. Alexus Grynkewich is set to present it in Poland on October 12. The concept combines conventional ground forces with low-cost drones, systems requiring minimal human intervention and AI-based guidance. The strategy emphasizes NATO’s defensive posture and aims to demonstrate that an adversary cannot achieve victory. #NATO

items.title: ❗️Ukraine’s 7th Air Assault Corps was redirected to the Zaporizhzhia axis after Mykhailo Drapatyi became commander-in-chief, Ukrainska Pravda reports. His predecessor, Oleksandr Syrskyi, had sent the corps command from the Dobropillia axis to Volyn in preparation for a potential offensive from Belarus. Ukrainska Pravda says Russian forces are now massing near Huliaipole with the aim of developing a large maneuver to encircle Zaporizhzhia. #Ukraine

items.title: Satellite analysis of Russia’s Ilsky refinery after the September 26 FP-1 drone strike indicates that all of its primary processing capacity was hit. At least six impacts were identified on equipment belonging to the AVT-5 and AVT-6 units, which provide most of the refinery’s processing capacity. The smaller AVT-3 unit burned extensively. Two additional impacts were identified on technical overpasses in the northern section, along with an oil spill in the tank farm. #Russia

items.title: RT by @ChrisO_wiki: 🇺🇦 Some highlights from a recent Telegraph article on the Ukrainian operations on the Oleksandrivka front. - The shaping operation enabling the armored maneuver elements of the operation took up to 8 months. - Ukraine hacked the smartphones of Russian troops and used their social media (used in lieu of a proper BMS) messages to correct fires. - Systemic targeting of UAS positions forced Russian UAS and C-UAS crews to fall back to safer positions further from the front. - The mid-strike campaign focused on hitting logistical targets depleted frontline supplies in the area (seeing the same play out north of Lyman). - Ukrainian infiltration teams went in first, avoiding Russian positions that were too fortified to take. Later recon units were tasked with clearing those positions. - Ukrainian soldiers would cross rivers like the Vovcha by swimming across them and having fresh clothing and equipment delivered to them by drone afterwards. - Once the ground had been cleared by the infantry, tanks rolled in to provide direct fire support against waves of Russian counterattacks. https://www.telegraph.co.uk/world-news/2026/10/03/how-ukraine-cracked-russias-kill-zone/
items.summary:
🇺🇦 Some highlights from a recent Telegraph article on the Ukrainian operations on the Oleksandrivka front.
- The shaping operation enabling the armored maneuver elements of the operation took up to 8 months.
- Ukraine hacked the smartphones of Russian troops and used their social media (used in lieu of a proper BMS) messages to correct fires.
- Systemic targeting of UAS positions forced Russian UAS and C-UAS crews to fall back to safer positions further from the front.
- The mid-strike campaign focused on hitting logistical targets depleted frontline supplies in the area (seeing the same play out north of Lyman).
- Ukrainian infiltration teams went in first, avoiding Russian positions that were too fortified to take. Later recon units were tasked with clearing those positions.
- Ukrainian soldiers would cross rivers like the Vovcha by swimming across them and having fresh clothing and equipment delivered to them by drone afterwards.
- Once the ground had been cleared by the infantry, tanks rolled in to provide direct fire support against waves of Russian counterattacks.

items.titleUk: RT by @DefenceHQ: On the Day of Defenders of Ukraine, the Defence Attachés of the British Embassy pay tribute to all those who defend Ukraine’s sovereignty and independence.
